race.comment: THINK BACK (5) led for home but found the chasing pack too strong last start in a BM66 over 1450m at Muswellbrook. Back in grade today and should slot into the perfect position out of gate one. The wet conditions pose no fears based on two strong efforts on soft tracks to launch this campaign. Cherry ripe after four runs back and looks the testing material. MORE CASH (2) failed two back at Dubbo under a crushing weight then revelled in the heavy going at Inverell last time, scoring by nearly eight lengths over today's trip. Up in grade but the track conditions bring him right into calculations. ZOU BIG BOY (1) has been freshened up since leading but just failing to hold on over the mile at Tamworth a month ago. A real swimmer who should be prominent for a long way. BLAZED PRINCE (8) ran a nice race in a similar contest at Tamworth last time. Solid each-way hope. Hard to make a case for the other runners.
